responsibility: Owns MSP430 MCU database lookup and devices.csv discovery/parsing shared by both the compiler proper and the driver. It resolves support-file locations from environment variables and installed toolchain paths, normalizes and trims paths, parses MCU names into extracted_mcu_data, validates revision and hardware-multiplier properties, and provides the large built-in fallback table mapping device names to ISA revision and multiplier capabilities. Other MSP430 files consume this data to infer -mcpu defaults, choose libraries, warn about option/MCU mismatches, and locate support headers/scripts.
same_name_distinction: Implements the MSP430 device-data interface: it contains the actual path-search and devices.csv parsing logic plus the built-in fallback MCU table used at runtime by both driver and backend. Unlike msp430-devices.h, this is the concrete implementation and data-definition file, not just the shared declarations and struct definition.
